name: utility
description: This represents common utility functions that are part of the C++ standard library and available in most programs by including headers such as <utility> or <algorithm>.

swap.desc: Exchanges the values of two objects.

move.desc: Converts an object to an rvalue reference to enable move semantics.

forward.desc: Perfectly forwards an argument to another function while preserving its value category (lvalue/rvalue).

exchange.desc: Replaces the value of an object with a new value and returns the old value.

as_const.desc: Obtains a const reference to an object.

min.desc: Returns the smaller of two values (or smallest in an initializer_list).

max.desc: Returns the larger of two values (or largest in an initializer_list).

clamp.desc: Returns a value clamped between a lower and an upper bound.
